content.title: RAF 07 Tsarukyan vs. Poullas 2 live discussion, results and highlights
content.text: Real American Freestyle (RAF) returns TONIGHT (Sat., March 28, 2026) with its seventh event, streaming live from Yuengling Center of the University of South Florida in Tampa, FloridaIn the RAF 07 main event, No. 1-ranked Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC) Lightweight and almost-title challenger Arman Tsarukyan collides with Georgio Poullas in a heated rematch — in which a brawl broke out after their first meeting.The co-main event features three-time UFC title challenger Colby Covington and former all-around troublemaker Dillon Danis in a match that should be utter chaos. In addition, four title fights are scheduled to go down on a ridiculously stacked card.RAF 07 kicks off at 8 p.m. ET and airs exclusively on FOX Nation.Below, you’ll find live results, highlights, and discussion throughout the evening.RAF 06 Results and Highlights:RAF 07 Main Event175 lbs: Arman Tsarukyan defeats Georgio Poullas 2 via points, 9-3RAF 07 Co-Main Event190 lbs: Colby Covington defeats Dillon Danis via Tech-Fall (14-4)RAF 07 Main Card190 lbs: Kyle Dake defeats Parker Keckeisen via points, 7-1 - Cruiserweight championship match215 lbs: Kyle Snyder defeats Akhmed Tazhudinov via Criteria, 3-3 - Light Heavyweight championship match150 lbs: Kennedy Blades defeats Milana Dudieva via Tech-Fall (11-0) - Middleweight championship match285 lbs: Wyatt Hendrickson defeats Trent Hillger via points, 6-2 - Heavyweight championship match145 lbs: Bo Bassett defeats Vladimer Khinchegashvili via Tech-Fall 13-3 (3rd period)190 lbs: Aeoden Sinclair defeats Khidir Saipudinov via points, 9-4175 lbs: Jason Nolf defeats Tajmuraz Salkazanov via Tech-Fall, 10-0 (1st period)215 lbs: Trent Hidlay defeats Pat Downey via Tech-Fall, 12-0 (2nd period)145 lbs: Johnni DiJulius defeats Conor Beebe via points, 9-6For the latest combat sports-related news and notes click here.
